Scenario: Clients view opens from workspace nav
Preconditions: Tester can sign in with an active staff account.
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Click Clients in the workspace nav or open /app?view=clients.
Expected Result: The Clients page loads with the heading Clients and the Clients navigation item selected.

Scenario: Initial client list displays table columns
Preconditions: At least one client exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Review the table.
Expected Result: The table shows Client, Contact, Appointments, and Last activity columns.

Scenario: Empty client state displays clear guidance
Preconditions: No clients exist in the environment.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients.
Expected Result: The page shows No clients found with guidance to add a client or create one from a confirmed booking.

Preconditions: At least two clients exist with different names.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Type a known client name in Search clients. 3. Wait for refresh.
Expected Result: The URL q parameter updates and the table shows matching clients only.

Preconditions: A client with an email address exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Search for part of the client's email.
Expected Result: The matching client appears and unrelated clients are filtered out.

Preconditions: A client with a phone number exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Search for part of the phone number.
Expected Result: The matching client appears and unrelated clients are filtered out.

Preconditions: At least one client exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Search for a string that should not match any client.
Expected Result: The page shows No clients found with Try a different search.

Scenario: Client pagination works when more than 25 clients exist
Preconditions: More than 25 client records exist.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Click Next. 3. Click Previous.
Expected Result: The page number and URL page parameter update, and the client list changes without breaking the search field.

Scenario: Add client button is visible to owner
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients.
Expected Result: The Add client button is visible.

Scenario: Add client button is visible to manager
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as manager.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients.
Expected Result: The Add client button is visible.

Scenario: Add client button is hidden for piercer
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as piercer.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients.
Expected Result: The Add client button is not visible.

Scenario: Dialog opens and focuses first field
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner or manager.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Click Add client.
Expected Result: The Add client dialog opens with First name, Last name, Email, and Phone fields; focus starts in First name.

Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner or manager.
Steps: 1. Open Add client dialog. 2. Leave one or more required fields empty. 3. Click Save client.
Expected Result: The browser or form prevents submission and the dialog remains open.

Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner or manager.
Steps: 1. Open Add client dialog. 2. Enter valid names and phone. 3. Enter an invalid email. 4. Click Save client.
Expected Result: The form rejects the invalid email before saving.

Preconditions: Use a unique email address not already in the system.
Steps: 1. Open Add client dialog. 2. Enter first name, last name, valid email, and phone. 3. Click Save client.
Expected Result: The dialog closes, the workspace refreshes, and the new client appears in the list or can be found by search.

Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner or manager.
Steps: 1. Open Add client dialog. 2. Enter sample values. 3. Click Cancel.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and no new client is created.

Scenario: Escape closes dialog when not saving
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as owner or manager.
Steps: 1. Open Add client dialog. 2. Press Escape.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and focus returns to the page.

Preconditions: At least one client exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Click a client row.
Expected Result: A client dialog opens showing the client name, client since date, email link, phone link, and Appointment history section.

Preconditions: At least one client exists.
Steps: 1. Focus a client row with keyboard navigation. 2. Press Enter or Space.
Expected Result: The client dialog opens.

Preconditions: The selected client has permitted appointments.
Steps: 1. Open a client record. 2. Wait for Appointment history to load.
Expected Result: Appointment history shows booking status, date/time, reference, services, piercer, station, sale state, and notes.

Preconditions: The selected client has no permitted appointments for the tester role.
Steps: 1. Open the client's record. 2. Wait for Appointment history to load.
Expected Result: The dialog shows No permitted appointments are available for this client.

Scenario: Mail and phone links are usable
Preconditions: Selected client has email and phone values.
Steps: 1. Open a client record. 2. Inspect or click the email and phone links.
Expected Result: Email uses a mailto link and phone uses a tel link with the client's saved contact values.

Preconditions: A client dialog is open.
Steps: 1. Click Close client record.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and the client list remains visible.

Scenario: Clients view remains usable on mobile width
Preconditions: Browser dev tools or mobile device is available.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=clients. 2. Resize viewport to mobile width. 3. Test search, table/list, and dialogs.
Expected Result: Search, action buttons, table content, and dialogs remain readable and usable without overlapping controls.
